description: This file contains code for generating a course-wise assessment report in an educational ERP system, including data retrieval, processing, and chart data preparation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the assessment report, returning columns, data, and chart info.

methods.name: get_formatted_result
methods.description: Retrieves and formats assessment results based on provided filters and options.

methods.name: get_column
methods.description: Generates column definitions for the report based on assessment criteria.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares data for chart visualization based on grades and criteria.

methods.name: get_child_assessment_groups
methods.description: Fetches child assessment groups if the given group is a parent group.
